agent_discovery.description: Deliberately establish a new local spatial origin from the robot's current stationary pose. This resets the Local VIO session epoch, clears epoch-bound accumulated world observations, and revokes active stationary-workcell calibrations before the origin changes. Use it to recover from VIO drift or to define a new local origin, not as a routine readiness check.
when_to_use: The operator explicitly asks to reset, re-zero, re-origin, or readjust Midbrain's local spatial frame.
Local VIO has drifted or recovered with an origin that the operator no longer accepts.
A new physical setup requires all subsequent world-space observations to use a fresh epoch.
when_not_to_use: The request only needs camera or VIO Providers started; use Provider lifecycle control instead.
An existing TRACKING epoch remains suitable for the task.
The robot or camera cannot remain stationary during gravity and origin initialization.
side_effects: Acquires a Manager motion-inhibit lease while the spatial origin is established.
May start the camera and Local VIO Providers.
Revokes active stationary-workcell calibrations before changing the VIO epoch.
Clears accumulated world-point observations that belong to the previous epoch.

reason.description: Why a new local spatial origin is required.
